Raahil Muhammad Wildan.

I’m a cybersecurity student and bug hunter. I test web apps and APIs, especially the places where one user’s access ends and another’s begins.

I got my start in a data center and taught network routing. I still like to trace a request from one system to the next. When a check keeps coming up, I write a small tool for it.

One report started with a feature that fetched pictures. It turned out the server could read its own files through it. I wrote up what I could verify and how the team could fix it.
